dataset_metadata.name: XJTU Battery Dataset – LISHEN 18650 NCM Cycling to Failure
dataset_metadata.citation: Wang, F., Zhai, Z., Zhao, Z. et al. Physics-informed neural network for lithium-ion battery degradation stable modeling and prognosis. Nat Commun 15, 4332 (2024). https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-024-48779-z
dataset_metadata.funding: National Natural Science Foundation of China (52105116, 92060302); Fundamental Research Funds for the Central Universities (xzy022023060)

cell_info.cell_notes: Chemical composition LiNi0.5Co0.2Mn0.3O2. Charge cut-off 4.2 V, discharge cut-off 2.5 V.

aging_modes.notes: 6 batches: Batch-1 (8 cells, 2C charge / 1C discharge), Batch-2 (15 cells, 3C charge / 1C discharge), Batch-3 (8 cells, 2C charge / variable discharge {0.5,1,2,3,5}C), Batch-4 (8 cells, 2C charge / variable discharge {0.5,1,2,3,5}C to 3.0V, not fully discharged), Batch-5 (8 cells, random-walk discharge, not fully discharged), Batch-6 (8 cells, GEO satellite charge/discharge simulation). All batches use CC-CV charging. Experiment ran Sep 16 2022 – Feb 18 2023; all cells reached EOL.

time_protocol.notes: Experiment started September 16, 2022 and ended February 18, 2023. A few pauses occurred due to power outages; data has been consolidated. Temperature compensation data recorded separately in a dedicated channel (Temperature_Compensation_Data.mat).

rawdata.data_quality_notes: Some pauses due to power outages; data publicly released has been consolidated. Temperature compensation data stored separately.
rawdata.known_issues: Occasional power outage interruptions during experiment.

checkup.notes: Checkup intervals vary by batch: Batch-4 measures capacity after every cycle (CC-CV 2C to 4.2V, then 1C to 2.5V); Batch-5 measures capacity every 11 cycles (1 capacity measurement + 10 random discharge cycles); Batch-6 measures capacity approximately every 5 cycles (CC-CV 1C to 4.2V, then 0.5C to 2.5V). Batches 1–3 record per-cycle capacity from the main cycling data.

notes: Dataset published alongside the PINN-based SOH estimation paper (Nature Communications 2024). The XJTU dataset is one of four datasets used in the paper; the others (TJU, HUST, MIT) are third-party datasets. Python preprocessing code available at https://github.com/wang-fujin/Battery-dataset-preprocessing-code-library. Summary of papers using this dataset at https://github.com/wang-fujin/XJTU-Battery-Dataset-Papers-Summary.
